headline: Mexico's economic activity falls 0.7% in September, its largest decline since January
summary: Mexico's economic activity contracted 0.7% month on month in September, its first decline in three months and the sharpest since January, according to INEGI.
why: Monthly activity data from Mexico's statistics agency INEGI is a key gauge of the health of Latin America's second-largest economy and shapes expectations for central bank policy.
original_headline: Actividad económica de México cae 0.7% en septiembre, su mayor descenso desde enero
